name: Rock Drawings in Valcamonica
description: In the Camonica Valley of northern Italy's Lombardy region, prehistoric people pecked more than 140,000 figures into smooth rock surfaces over about 8,000 years. Walking among the stones, you can spot scenes of farming, boats, warriors and magical symbols. Newer finds may push the total far higher, and the densest clusters lie around Capo di Ponte, Nadro and Paspardo.
